about: Every staging build, newest first. The top version always matches package.json. Each entry's checks are what to run on staging before a promote. Live = main's package.json version; staging may be at most 5 builds ahead (scripts/check-release.mjs). Plain words about the change only, never anything a user typed.

releases.title: R2 Feel: remembered Quick or Normal, your last AI first, result reveal, words box that fits
items: Quick or Normal is remembered on this device, saved right next to the 4 slider numbers. It is a setting, never your words. New prompt keeps it and the sliders for the rest of the visit, while My context picks clear like before.

In the dock's ⋯ menu, the AI you opened last is listed first under Open in. The main button stays Copy prompt. This lasts for the open tab only: nothing is saved, and a reload puts the list back in its usual order.
When your prompt finishes, the card slides up gently and Copy prompt pulses once. With Reduce Motion on, the card fades in and the button gets a quick highlight, and nothing moves.

The words box fits what you type. Empty, it keeps its height so the 💡 ideas fit. Once you type or paste it fits your words (3 lines at least), grows up to about 40% of the screen, then scrolls inside, so Build my prompt stays right under your words and on screen.

checks.say: Tap Normal, then close the tab and open the staging page again.
checks.see: Normal is still picked when it opens (and Quick stays picked if you choose Quick). Nothing you typed comes back.

checks.say: Tap Quick, type a few words, build, then tap ⋯ → New prompt.
checks.see: Quick is still picked, and the 4 sliders (open Not sure where to start?) are where you left them. My context picks are cleared, same as before.
checks.paste: need to plan a surprise birthday for my sister maya, saturday the 14th, maybe 12 people, her favorite is the lemon bakery downtown, keep it under 300 bucks

checks.say: Build a prompt. When it finishes, tap ⋯ and look under Open in. Tap Gemini (it opens in a new tab), come back, and tap ⋯ again.
checks.see: Before: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini. After opening Gemini: Gemini is listed first. The big button still says Copy prompt.

checks.say: Reload the page and build again.
checks.see: Open in is back to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, since this is tab-only memory.

checks.say: Build a prompt and watch the card as it finishes (try it once with a key and once without).
checks.see: The prompt card slides up about a quarter of a second, then Copy prompt in the dock pulses once. It pulses again only when you build or rebuild another prompt, never when you flip rounds or tap Undo.

checks.say: Turn on Reduce Motion in iPhone Settings → Accessibility → Motion, reload, and build.
checks.see: The card fades in with no sliding, and Copy prompt gets one quick glow instead of the pulse.

checks.say: Open the page with the box empty, then type one word, then paste the test note below four or five times in a row, so it becomes a long ramble.
checks.see: Empty: the box is tall enough for the 💡 ideas. One word: it shrinks to about 3 lines. The long ramble: it grows to about 40% of the screen, then scrolls inside, and Build my prompt stays right under it and on screen.
checks.paste: ok so the thing is the garage sale is saturday and i still have to price all the stuff from the attic, plus my brother said he might bring his old speakers, and the neighbors on both sides want to join so we need tables, maybe six, and somebody has to handle the cash box, also it might rain so i need a plan b, maybe the carport, idk

checks.say: Clear the box (select all, delete).
checks.see: It goes back to its tall empty height and the 💡 ideas come back.

releases.title: Up to 3 rounds, and Compare rounds side by side
items: Rework now goes up to 3 rounds. It builds the next round from whichever round you're looking at, so if round 2 went sideways you can go back to round 1 and rework from there.
The switcher on the card shows Round 1 / 2 / 3 with each round's score. At 3 rounds Rework goes away and the card says 3 is the max, so you pick your favorite or start fresh with more detail.

Compare rounds (on the switcher, for 2 or 3 rounds) lines the rounds up like a product comparison table: the Quality check score, then each part of a great prompt (who the AI is, the exact job, background, shape and length, and more) with ✓ or ✗. 🏆 marks the stronger round on each row where they differ, the top says Best overall and why, and Where they differ spells out what each round beats the others at. Use under a round flips to it.
Everything in the table comes from the Quality check each round already got, so opening it is instant and uses no extra Gemini calls. Nothing is saved.

checks.say: With run stats on and your key in, tap Copy test note, paste it, and build. When the Quality check is under 4.5, tap Rework, add a line at the bottom, and build round 2.
checks.see: Round 2 builds. The card shows Round 1 / Round 2 with scores, and a ⚖️ Compare rounds button under the switcher.
checks.paste: uh so the thing for saturday, need to sort it out, maybe ask around, idk

checks.say: Tap ⚖️ Compare rounds.
checks.see: A table with Round 1 and Round 2 side by side fits across the screen: Quality check on top, ✓ or ✗ for each part, 🏆 on the stronger round where they differ, Best overall with a reason, and a Where they differ list. The round on screen says Showing, the other has a Use button.

checks.say: Tap Use under the other round.
checks.see: The card flips to that round (prompt, score, box), the switcher follows, and the table stays open with Showing on the new round.

checks.say: If a round is still under 4.5, view it and tap Rework, add a line, and build round 3. (Try it from round 1 to see it build from there.)
checks.see: The box banner says Round 3 and Back to round 1 (or 2, whichever you were on). Round 3 builds and the switcher shows all three.

checks.say: With 3 rounds, flip to any round and open Compare rounds.
checks.see: No Rework button on any round, and the card says 3 rounds is the max. All 3 columns fit on screen with no sideways scrolling.

checks.say: Tap New prompt.
checks.see: The switcher and the comparison go away, and the next prompt starts clean.

releases.title: Fix session: your core shapes the prompt, Round 1 / Round 2 switcher
items: Use my core no longer tacks a MY CORE block onto the end of your prompt. The writer uses it to shape the prompt instead (who you are, how you like answers, the AI's role), working in only what fits. With no key, it sits inside the prompt's background, before your thoughts.
Your core counts as your own words, so the number check, X-ray and Quality check don't treat it as made up.

Rework no longer throws round 2 away. Once round 2 is built, the card shows a Round 1 / Round 2 switcher with each round's score, so you can flip back and forth and keep the one you like. Both stay until you start a new prompt (in memory only, never saved).
Back to round 1 while you're still editing keeps your edits, so Rework picks up where you left off.

checks.say: Turn on Show my dev tools and Use my core (with something in it), tap Copy test note, paste it, and build with your key.
checks.see: The finished prompt reads like it knows you (your style or the AI's role is worked in), and there is no MY CORE block at the end. Copy prompt copies just the prompt.
checks.paste: help me plan my week, gym monday wednesday friday, quiz thursday for the security class, and i keep forgetting to call my aunt

checks.say: Same core on, but take your key out (or use a fresh staging tab without one) and build any note.
checks.see: The quick version shows your core inside the prompt, before MY RAW THOUGHTS, and the prompt ends with your thoughts. Nothing tacked on after.

checks.say: With run stats on and your key in, tap Copy test note, paste it, and build. When the Quality check is under 4.5, tap Rework from this prompt, add a line at the bottom, and tap Build my prompt.
checks.see: Round 2 builds. The card shows a Round 1 / Round 2 switcher with Round 2 picked and each round's score next to its name.
checks.paste: uh so the thing for saturday, need to sort it out, maybe ask around, idk

checks.say: On that card, tap Round 1, then Round 2, then Round 1 again.
checks.see: Each tap swaps the whole card: the prompt, the Quality check, the made-by line and the words in the box. Nothing is lost going either way, and Round 1 has no Rework button.

checks.say: Tap New prompt (or change the box and build fresh).
checks.see: The switcher goes away and the new prompt starts clean, with no leftover rounds.

checks.say: Build the Saturday note again, tap Rework, type an extra line, then tap ← Back to round 1. Tap Rework from this prompt again.
checks.see: Back to round 1 brings the first prompt back. Rework puts your edited text back in the box, extra line included, instead of starting over.

releases.title: R1 fixes: Build under the box, Copy stays after a change, test notes
items: Build my prompt is back right under the box. The dock only shows its own Build my prompt once you scroll past the box, so it's never on screen twice.

Change your words (or Quick or Normal, Use my core, My context) on a finished prompt and Copy prompt stays. The dock shows Copy prompt and Rebuild side by side, and ⋯ still has Open in and New prompt, so one stray word never takes your prompt away.
Test lab: a check that asks you to paste a note now gives you one, with a Copy test note button. Picked so the step actually happens (the questions one is written to get questions).

checks.say: Open staging with an empty box and look under it, then scroll down past the box.
checks.see: Build my prompt sits right under the box and the pill is out of the way. Past the box, the pill slides in with Build my prompt. Scroll back up and it slides away again.

checks.say: Tap Copy test note, paste it in the box, close the keyboard, scroll down past the box, and tap Build my prompt in the pill.
checks.see: It builds. While it works both Build buttons say Working... and can't be tapped twice.
checks.paste: plan my week: gym monday wednesday friday, study for the quiz thursday, call my aunt sometime, and the car needs an oil change

checks.say: On the finished prompt, add one word to the box, close the keyboard, and scroll down.
checks.see: The pill shows Copy prompt (outlined) and Rebuild (filled). Copy prompt copies the prompt you already had.
checks.paste: ok so me and a few friends want to do a trip somewhere warm sometime soon, nobody can agree on where, some want beach some want a city, we don't want to spend crazy money but idk the budget yet, can you help us figure out a plan

checks.say: Still there, tap ⋯ in the pill.
checks.see: Open in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and New prompt are all there.

checks.say: Tap Rebuild.
checks.see: It builds again with your new words, and the pill goes back to just Copy prompt.

checks.say: Open the 🧪 Test lab and go to any check with a test note.
checks.see: The note shows under You should see, with 📋 Copy test note. Tapping it says Copied, and the note pastes into the box.

releases.title: Undo brings back the prompt too
items: Undo after New prompt now brings everything back, not just your words: the finished prompt with its notes, X-ray, and Quality check, or the questions with the answers you'd already given. Mid-build there's nothing finished yet, so only your words come back. Still memory only, never saved.

checks.say: Build a prompt, tap ⋯ then New prompt, then tap Undo.
checks.see: Your words and the whole prompt card come back, scrolled into view, and the dock says Copy prompt. Copy prompt copies that same prompt.

checks.say: With your key, start a prompt, answer one question, tap ⋯ then New prompt, then Undo.
checks.see: The questions come back with your answer, and the dock says Write my prompt (1 of 3).

checks.say: After an Undo, change a word in the box, close the keyboard, and scroll down.
checks.see: The dock shows Copy prompt (the prompt you got back) and Rebuild side by side.

releases.title: R1 build 2: Copy under the prompt, New prompt with Undo, Ctrl or ⌘ + Enter
items: Copy under the prompt: Copy prompt + my note now sits right under the prompt, with Report and Remember for next time? after it. Copy prompt itself stays in the dock.

New prompt with Undo: after New prompt, a small Prompt cleared · Undo pill shows for 6 seconds just above the dock (or the keyboard). Undo puts your words back in the box so a mis-tap never loses a transcript. Typing something new makes it go away. Kept in memory only, and the old prompt isn't brought back: build again from your words.
Ctrl or ⌘ + Enter in the box builds, for iPad keyboards and computers. Plain Enter is still a new line.
Fix from build 1: after building a second time, changing Quick or Normal, Use my core, or My context now switches the dock back to Build my prompt like it should.

checks.say: Build a prompt and look under it.
checks.see: Copy prompt + my note sits right under the prompt box. Something went wrong? and Remember for next time? come after it. Copy prompt is still in the dock.

checks.say: Tap ⋯ in the dock, then New prompt.
checks.see: The box empties and a dark Prompt cleared · Undo pill shows just above the dock, with a thin line shrinking for about 6 seconds.

checks.say: Tap Undo.
checks.see: Your words are back in the box and the dock says Build my prompt.

checks.say: Tap New prompt again and start typing something new.
checks.see: The Undo pill goes away as soon as you type.

checks.say: Tap New prompt and wait.
checks.see: The Undo pill goes away by itself after about 6 seconds.

checks.say: With the 💡 Ideas tab on, tap New prompt.
checks.see: 💡 Ideas slides up above the Undo pill, so nothing overlaps.

checks.say: On an iPad with a keyboard (or a computer), tap Copy test note, paste it in the box, and press ⌘ + Enter (Ctrl + Enter on Windows).
checks.see: It builds, same as tapping Build my prompt. Plain Enter still makes a new line.
checks.paste: plan my week: gym monday wednesday friday, study for the quiz thursday, call my aunt sometime, and the car needs an oil change

checks.say: With your key, build a prompt, change only Quick or Normal, then scroll down to the dock.
checks.see: The dock shows Copy prompt and Rebuild, so you can rebuild with the new mode or still copy the one you have.

releases.title: R1 build 1: Next step dock
items: Next step dock: a floating pill at the bottom of every screen holds the one button you need right now, and it's the only place that button lives. Writing your thoughts: Build my prompt. Questions: Write my prompt (N of 3), which works even at 0 of 3. Result: Copy prompt.

The ⋯ next to it holds the rest: on the result, Open in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini (copies and opens, like before) and New prompt (was Start over); on the questions, Quick version (the faster, lighter write, was Quick prompt) and New prompt.
Change your words after a build and the dock switches back to Build my prompt, so you can rebuild without scrolling up.

The dock tucks away while the keyboard is up, while X-ray, the Tutorial, or a panel is open, and fades back in when they close. The page ends above it, and the 💡 Ideas and 🧪 Test lab buttons and the first-run Guide stack on the right just above it.
Motion kit: one set of speeds (150ms taps, 250ms reveals, about 400ms scrolls) and one easing curve, starting with the dock. With Reduce Motion on, the dock just appears and goes instead of sliding.

checks.say: Open staging on your iPhone with an empty box, then scroll down past the box.
checks.see: At the top, Build my prompt sits right under the box and the pill is out of the way. Once you scroll past the box, the pill slides in with Build my prompt and nothing else. The footer stops above it, never behind it.

checks.say: Tap into the box so the keyboard opens, then tap outside it.
checks.see: The pill slides away while the keyboard is up, and fades back in quickly once it closes.

checks.say: With your key and Normal picked, tap Copy test note, paste it in the box (keyboard closed), and tap Build my prompt.
checks.see: It builds like before. When questions show, the pill says Write my prompt (0 of 3) (or however many), and the number goes up as you answer.
checks.paste: ok so me and a few friends want to do a trip somewhere warm sometime soon, nobody can agree on where, some want beach some want a city, we don't want to spend crazy money but idk the budget yet, can you help us figure out a plan

checks.say: On the questions, tap ⋯ in the pill.
checks.see: A small menu opens above it: Quick version (faster, lighter) and New prompt. Tapping outside closes it. Quick version writes the prompt the fast way.

checks.say: Answer the questions and tap Write my prompt in the pill.
checks.see: When the prompt is ready the pill says Copy prompt. Tapping it copies (it turns green for a moment) and the copied line shows on the card.

checks.say: On the result, tap ⋯ and then Claude.
checks.see: The menu shows Open in: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, then New prompt. Claude copies the prompt and opens Claude, and the menu closes.

checks.say: Back on the result, type one more word into the thoughts box at the top and close the keyboard.
checks.see: Build my prompt shows under the box and the pill keeps Copy prompt. Scroll down and the pill shows Copy prompt and Rebuild side by side.

checks.say: Tap 🩻 X-ray on the result, then Done.
checks.see: The pill is gone while X-ray is open and comes back after Done.

checks.say: Turn on Show my Ideas tab (and dev tools for the Test lab) and look at the bottom right.
checks.see: 💡 Ideas sits on the right just above the pill, with 🧪 Test lab stacked above it. Nothing overlaps the pill.

checks.say: On an iPad or computer, open staging.
checks.see: The pill is centered, not stretched edge to edge, and works the same way.

releases.title: Build 4: floating Done, snap to the cooking, keyboard coach bar
items: My context: the + Add another and Done bar floats at the bottom of the screen while the editor is open, and sits on top of the keyboard while you type, so Done is always one tap away. The floating 💡 Ideas and 🧪 Test lab buttons tuck away while it's open (and while the keyboard coach bar is up), so they never cover it.
Snap to the cooking: Build closes the keyboard and scrolls straight to the cooking ring, the one under Build while it reads your thoughts, then the prompt card's ring while it writes.

Keyboard coach bar: while you type with the keyboard up, a slim bar rides on top of it with the Prompt strength meter and one tap-to-add chip (the Stuck? nudge when it shows, else the coach's top tip). Taps keep the keyboard up. Close the keyboard and they're back under the box.

Test lab rail: ▶ Continue at the top always walks the checks you haven't marked yet, even when something's broken (Re-check still walks the broken ones). After ✗ Broken there's a Continue to the next check button, and tapping any check carries on along the rail from there.

checks.say: Dev tools on: My context > + New, then + Add another 3 times, and scroll up and down through the pieces.
checks.see: The + Add another and Done bar floats at the bottom of the screen the whole time, and the 💡 Ideas and 🧪 Test lab buttons tuck away so nothing covers it. Tapping Done closes the editor and the two buttons come back.

checks.say: In My context, tap into one of the big text boxes so the keyboard opens.
checks.see: The + Add another and Done bar sits right on top of the keyboard, not behind it.

checks.say: With your key, type a short note, and with the keyboard still open tap Build my prompt.
checks.see: The keyboard closes and the page snaps to the cooking ring under Build while it says Reading your thoughts, then to the ring on the prompt card while it writes.

checks.say: Tap the thoughts box and type help me plan a yard sale (keyboard up).
checks.see: A slim bar sits on top of the keyboard: 👻 with the strength meter and a + tip chip. Tapping the tip adds a new line and the keyboard stays up.

checks.say: Keep the keyboard up, type a few more words, then stop for about 6 seconds.
checks.see: ✍️ Stuck? sentence shows in the bar on top of the keyboard (not under the box). 🎲 swaps it, tapping it adds the line, and the keyboard stays up.

checks.say: Close the keyboard (tap outside the box).
checks.see: The bar is gone, and Prompt strength and the nudge are back under the box.

checks.say: In this Test lab, tap any check you haven't done, mark it ✗ Broken, type test, then tap Continue to the next check. Go back to it and tap ✓ Works when you're done.
checks.see: Continue opens the next check you haven't marked. Back at the list, ▶ Continue · N not checked sits at the top and picks up where you left off.

releases.title: Build 3: Start here, stuck nudge, leaving mid-build, prompt cooking
items: Start here: when the app opens, the title's waveform entrance plays first, then one white halo panel pulses around the title, waveform and description, then the page scrolls down to Talk it out and the box, which pulse with ✍️ Start here, then the idea strip comes in. It plays on every open until your first tap, type, paste or Talk it out, then never again. Only a yes/no flag is kept, never anything typed.

Stuck? After the box sits still for about 6 seconds with some words in it, one sentence to finish shows under it, aimed at what your thoughts are missing. Tap it to start that line, 🎲 for another. There's no ✕, so a stray tap can't switch them off: they come back after every quiet stretch.

Leaving mid-build: if a step drops while you're in another app, it tries the same model again when you're back instead of spending a backup. Back before it finishes: it says Picked back up. Finished while you were away: the tab title says Prompt ready and coming back says Ready while you were away.

Prompt cooking: a big ring wraps the timer with a kitchen inside. Your pieces fly in as chips and splash into the pot, the spoon stirs, it bubbles and steams, and the chef talk changes every few seconds. Slow? The lid goes on and rattles. A model handing off: the pot shakes, foam spills, the flames flare and it slides to a new burner. Done: the cloche lifts on your plated prompt with sparkles and the ring turns green. Reduce Motion keeps it still.
Build row: while it works, a longer label like Reading your thoughts... wraps inside the Build button, so Quick and Normal keep their full size and the row doesn't jump.

Test lab: 📋 Copy report for Claude. Mark a check ✗ Broken, type what happened, tap it, and every broken check (Do, Expected, What happened) is on your clipboard, ready to paste into the chat. The Ideas jar is still there as the other option.

checks.say: Open staging in a new Private tab in Safari (a fresh visit).
checks.see: First the waveform under the title plays and settles into lines. Then one roomy white halo panel wraps the title, waveform and description, and in light mode the rest of the page dims like a spotlight. Nothing on the page moves. After about 2 seconds the page scrolls down so Talk it out and the box sit at the top, both with the white halo, the spotlight moves to that card, and ✍️ Start here shows in the box. About 4 seconds later it fades and the idea strip comes in.

checks.say: In that Private tab, reload without touching anything.
checks.see: The waveform, the title halo and the scroll to the box play again, because you haven't done anything yet.

checks.say: Still in the Private tab: tap into the box, type a word, then reload.
checks.see: Start here is gone for good and the ideas show right away. Your word is not kept.

checks.say: Type help me plan a yard sale, then stop and wait about 6 seconds.
checks.see: ✍️ Stuck? Finish this: shows one sentence. 🎲 swaps it. Tapping it starts a new line with that sentence and the cursor after it.

checks.say: Wait for the nudge to come back, then type a few more words and wait 6 seconds again.
checks.see: There's no ✕. Typing tucks it away, and a new nudge shows after the next quiet stretch.

checks.say: With your key and Quick mode, build, and as soon as the pot shows, switch to another app for about 5 seconds, then come back.
checks.see: The pot says 👋 Welcome back, still simmering, and when the prompt shows, the card says Picked back up.

checks.say: With your key, build any prompt and watch the ring.
checks.see: A big ring wraps the timer with a pot inside. Chips (Your thoughts, plus any answers or context) fly in and splash, the spoon stirs, the chef line changes every few seconds, then the cloche lifts on a plated prompt with sparkles and the ring turns green.

checks.say: Open the staging link with #cookdemo on the end (kmagno94.github.io/speak-to-prompt/staging/#cookdemo).
checks.see: A preview cook plays with no Gemini call: chips fly in, around 6 seconds the lid goes on and rattles, around 10 seconds the pot shakes, foams over and slides to a new burner (💥 Boiled over!), then 🍽️ Order up! with the cloche lifting.

checks.say: With your key, tap Build my prompt and watch the Build row while it says Reading your thoughts...
checks.see: The label wraps onto 2 lines inside the button. Quick and Normal stay full size with room around them, and nothing jumps.

checks.say: In this Test lab, open any check, tap ✗ Broken, type test note, tap 📋 Copy report for Claude, and paste it into Notes. Then tap ✓ Works on that check.
checks.see: It says Copied. The paste starts with Test lab report, staging v2.1.6, and lists that check with Do, Expected, and What happened: test note.

releases.title: Build 2: context budget, Rework as round 2
items: My context has a budget: the chip shows about how many tokens your picks add and the % of 1,500.

Past 100%, a build with your key squeezes the picks once with Flash-Lite: every fact stays, filler goes. The chip shows before and after. The short version is memory only, so your saved pieces never change.

Rework is now round 2: your prompt goes back in the box with one What was weak line on top. Change anything, then Build. Round 2 uses your original thoughts and answers plus your edits, with no new questions.
Round 2 shows on the timer with the running total for both rounds, and the card shows the score before and after.
Save to Notes after round 2 keeps your original words with the new prompt. Back to round 1 puts everything back. The old one-question rework in the card is gone.

checks.say: Dev tools on, no key: pick one short My context piece.
checks.see: The chip next to My context says about N tokens and a small %, like · 3%.

checks.say: With your key, pick My context pieces that add up past 100% (or paste a long piece), then build.
checks.see: Before: the chip is orange and says squeezes to fit when you build. The button says Squeezing your context to fit, then the chip says squeezed (before) → (after) tokens with a % near or under 100.

checks.say: After that squeeze, open My context > Edit and look at the long piece.
checks.see: Your saved words are exactly as you wrote them. Reload the page and pick them again: the chip is back to the full size.

checks.say: With run stats on, build a prompt that lands under the 4.5 bar, then tap 🔁 Rework from this prompt.
checks.see: The card steps aside. The box holds one line starting What was weak, a blank line, then your prompt. A Round 2 banner sits above the box with Back to round 1.

checks.say: Add a line to the box (like a budget), then tap Build my prompt.
checks.see: No new questions. The timer says Round 2 and total, both rounds. The ready line says Round 2 ready in Ns (Ms total, both rounds). The banner on the card shows Quality check before → after.

checks.say: Tap Save to Notes, then look at the note.
checks.see: Your original words (summary and transcript) with the new prompt under Prompt Built. No What was weak line anywhere.

checks.say: Tap ← Back to round 1 on the card.
checks.see: The first prompt, its grade, and your original words in the box are back, and 🔁 Rework from this prompt shows again.

releases.title: Build 1: Batch A, honest dates, prompt-only copy
items: Copy and open: a status line right under ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini says it copied (or what to do if it couldn't).
Start over forgets your transcript. If Paste finds the same one still on the clipboard, it warns you instead of bringing it back (Use it anyway if you mean it).
Ideas tab: Edit on any open idea.
Questions read clearer: the question is bold, the helper lines around it are small and gray.
The intro text on the first screen has room to breathe: each sentence on its own line, open spacing.
My context: the editor opens at its top with the cursor in a title, and a new piece goes first.

Dates stay as you said them: the writer keeps maybe and I think, adds no year, weekday, or month, and doesn't make a preference stronger (no strictly you didn't say). If your own weekday and date don't match, the prompt asks the AI to check instead of picking one. The Heads up note now also catches a weekday that doesn't match its date (Saturday the 30th when the 30th is a Friday).
The Quality check is docked below the bar whenever the number check flags something, and the grader bench runs the real Saturday example (B9) first.
Copy gives the prompt only: My context is no longer tacked on as a block. The writer works in just the facts the request needs, and your core stays at the end.

checks.say: Build any prompt, then tap ChatGPT under Copy and open.
checks.see: A green line right under the three links says "Copied. Opening ChatGPT: paste it there."

checks.say: Paste a transcript with 📋 Paste, build it, tap Start over, then tap 📋 Paste again without copying anything new.
checks.see: The box stays empty and a note says "That's the transcript you already used". Use it anyway pastes it.

checks.say: Open the 💡 Ideas tab, tap Edit on an open idea, change a word, tap Save. Then Edit again, type something, tap Cancel.
checks.see: Save keeps the new words. Cancel leaves it as it was.

checks.say: With your key, build a Normal prompt that asks a question.
checks.see: The question is bold. The "Got it" line above it and the "That's everything I need" line after are small and gray.

checks.say: Open staging fresh and read the intro under Speak to Prompt.
checks.see: Each sentence sits on its own line with more space around it, the first one a little darker. No emojis.

checks.say: With dev tools on and at least one My context piece saved, tap + New under My context.
checks.see: The editor scrolls to its top, the new empty piece is first, and the cursor is in its title.

checks.say: With your key, build from: "potluck at my place, a saturday I think? my friend is gluten free, like 8 people".
checks.see: The prompt keeps "I think", adds no month, day, or year, and says gluten free without "strictly". If it ever adds a date, a Heads up note names it (and the weekday if it is wrong).

checks.say: More options > Grader bench > Run grader bench (dev tools on).

releases.title: Test lab on staging
items: 🧪 Test lab on staging: every check for the builds that aren't live yet, oldest first, then the Before you promote checks.
Mark each one ✓ Works or ✗ Broken, add a note, and send a broken one to the 💡 Ideas jar as a 🔥 Now bug.
Re-check walks only the broken ones after a fix; Continue walks only what isn't ✓ yet.
When everything passes it says Ready to promote and copies the promote message for your Claude chat.
Opens from the 🧪 button bottom left (with Show my Ideas tab on) or straight from the staging link ending in #testlab. Never on live. Results are saved on this phone only.

checks.say: Open the staging link ending in #testlab on the iPhone.
checks.see: The Test lab opens on its own and the top line says Live v2.0.0, staging v2.1.3, 5/5 ahead.

checks.say: Tap Start, mark this step ✓ Works, then on the next one tap ✗ Broken and type a short note.
checks.see: The note box shows under the buttons and the 🧪 button bottom left says ✗ 1 broken after you close the panel.

checks.say: Open that broken step again and tap 💡 Add to Ideas jar.
checks.see: It says it's in the Ideas jar as a 🔥 Now bug, and the 💡 Ideas tab lists it.

checks.say: Close and reopen staging, then open the Test lab.
checks.see: Your ✓ and ✗ are still there, and the button says ▶ Re-check 1 fix.

checks.say: Open the live site.
checks.see: No 🧪 button, even with Show my Ideas tab on.

releases.title: Two-speed tests: quick staging, full suite for promote and live
items: Staging pushes deploy after the release check and a quick core set of 22 smoke tests, instead of the full suite on both versions.
Live is only re-tested on a staging push when main hasn't passed its own full run.
The full suite still runs on every staging push, in the background, and turns the run red if anything fails.
A pull request from staging into main runs the full suite on what goes live (Promote check), and the main deploy runs it again on both versions.

checks.say: Open the newest Test and deploy run for staging in the Actions tab.
checks.see: "Live not re-tested" note, the staging smoke step says (quick), and build plus deploy finish in a few minutes. "Full tests (staging, background)" finishes after and is green.

checks.say: Open staging on the iPhone after that run.
checks.see: The STAGING badge says v2.1.2.

releases.title: Release loop: N/5 limit and the full fix session
items: releases.json lists every staging build with the checks to run before promote.
Each staging deploy checks the list and stops if staging is more than 5 builds ahead of live.
Copy fix session now starts with the release limit check, ends with the N/5 count, and carries the promote steps and the 3-question loop check.

checks.say: Open the latest Test and deploy run on GitHub (Actions tab) and look at the Release check step.
checks.see: A Release limit note like "Staging is 3/5 ahead of live" and "Release check passed."

checks.see: It has a Release limit step before any code, a Queued for my jar table rule, releases.json, the Pre-flight passed, promote steps, and a Loop check. Delete the test idea after.

releases.title: Ideas tab, the journey pass, My context, Rework
items: Owner-only Ideas tab: log bugs, ideas and faster ways, Copy fix session, fixes close their own ideas through ideas-done.json.
Experience pass: Speak, Answer, Copy strip, one message style, Copy as the finish line, Quality check at a glance, motion.
My context (dev tools): reusable background picked per prompt.
Screen stays awake while Gemini works, and Rework from this prompt.
